title.rendered: ntop Winter Webinar: ntopng 6.6 and New ntop Software Releases

content.rendered:
Last week, we released a new release of the ntop tools: ntopng 6.6, nProbe 11.0, nDPI 5.0, Cento 2.4, PF_RING 9.2, and nScrub 1.8.

As we have implemented many new features, including a brand-new ntopng component designed for monitoring large networks, we would like to introduce all this with a webinar. The goal of this event is to go through the new features and show them live, in addition to Q&A at the end of the event.

For those who missed the event, please find enclosed below the presentation slides and the webinar video.

ntopWebinar_1225Download

Enjoy !
